game.title: New England Patriots at Chicago Bears

lede: Chicago Bears carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#8 in EPA per play), while New England Patriots owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#8 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Chicago Bears -0.6 with a fair total of 45.2 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is New England Patriots run offence vs Chicago Bears run defence, which sits +0.061 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: New England Patriots and Chicago Bears have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
